title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 19: Peace

scenes.say: He goes back to Roddy's hometown. Long drive. Quiet radio.
scenes.visual: a car driving down a two-lane country road at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Roddy's mother opens the door. She already knows who he is.
scenes.visual: a farmhouse front porch with an older woman in the doorway, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's carried this apology for fifteen years.
scenes.visual: a man standing on a porch holding a hat in his hands, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: That was my seat, ma'am. It should have been me.
scenes.visual: two people sitting at a farmhouse kitchen table, faces in shadow, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She takes his hand. Roddy wrote home about you.
scenes.visual: an older woman's hand covering a man's hand on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He said Newark would take care of him.
scenes.visual: a stack of old letters tied with ribbon on a table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You did, she says. You're still doing it, by living.
scenes.visual: sunlight spilling across a kitchen table with two coffee cups, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Fifteen years of guilt finally sets down.
scenes.visual: a man exhaling on a porch swing, eyes closed, golden light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Peace isn't forgetting. It's forgiving yourself.
scenes.visual: a wide field at sunset with tall grass moving in the wind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He drives home with the windows down for the first time in years.
scenes.visual: a hand out of a car window riding the wind on a country road, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a sunset over farmland, warm sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 19 of 25: Peace. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
